notes.title: “Once for all”
notes.intro: Hebrews stresses that Christ offered himself once for all, unlike repeated sacrifices.

views.label: The Mass makes present the one sacrifice
views.summary: Catholic and Orthodox Christians agree Christ’s sacrifice was once for all, and teach that the Eucharist makes that same sacrifice present, not a new one.

views.label: The Supper remembers a finished sacrifice
views.summary: Protestants stress that Christ’s sacrifice is finished; the Lord’s Supper is a thanksgiving and remembrance, not a sacrifice for sins.
views.source: Thirty-Nine Articles, Article XXXI; Westminster Confession 29.2
